puzzles.explanation: The third-person singular subject 'She' requires the auxiliary verb 'doesn't' instead of 'don't'.
The verb 'run' is irregular, so its simple past tense form is 'ran', not 'runned'.
An objective pronoun like 'him' must be used as the direct object of the verb 'called'.
The comparative form 'better' is already comparative and should not be paired with 'more'.
